description: Per-name AI-exposure classification consumed by the scanner and the brain. exposure is one of: ai_supplier (sells the AI buildout), ai_beneficiary (AI lowers costs / expands product), ai_neutral (moat orthogonal to AI), ai_at_risk (core product replicable or commoditized by frontier AI - the retail bear case). Maintained weekly by the universe review (WebSearch) under enum guardrails; seeded by hand.
